d: THE ARCHIVE’S INSTRUMENT DIVISION IS COMPOSED AS A CITATION: "Platform Erosion Observatory measures CUSTODY SEPARATION; the Capture Registry measures REPRESENTATION AND CORRECTION ASYMMETRY." And a full six-glyph AXN transmits.
reading:
THE INSTRUMENTS DESCRIBE THEIR OWN DIVISION OF LABOUR, IN A SOURCE CARD. Card 4 carries the taxonomy: the Platform Erosion Observatory measures CUSTODY SEPARATION, the Capture Registry measures REPRESENTATION AND CORRECTION ASYMMETRY, and heteronymic tracking follows. This registry’s own remit, stated by the archive and served by the layer as a description of the archive.

Card 2 supplies the specific casualty with its verification route: DOI 18459573 (Sappho 31) "under ACTIVE REGISTRY SEVERANCE, returning HTTP 404 from DataCite’s public API, following the 19 June 2026 termination". The claim, the method, and the date, in one snippet.

A FULL SIX-GLYPH AXN TRANSMITS: card 3 carries AXN:0421.EMPIRICAL with all six emoji intact. Fourth glyph outcome recorded — three full, one truncated to two.

The collision is COASTAL EROSION: OSIRISC, an integrated observatory for monitoring shoreline erosion and flood risk in Brittany. Two observatories of erosion, one of coastline and one of custody.
analysis: The layer defines the observatory as *an empirical digital tracking project that audits and records the silent removal, severance, and erasure of persistent identifiers (such as DOIs and digital records)*, and ties it — correctly — to the PID Erosion Observatory at persistentidentifiers.org, whose SERP title carries its own glyph string (🎭📐🐝🎪🏷️🎇 AXN:0421.EMPIRICAL · EA-EROSION-01). Core Focus Areas render identifier custody, removal censuses, and structural decay as the programme. The Academia organic carries live severance data — the Sappho 31 DOI *under active registry severance, returning HTTP 404 from DataCite’s public API, following the 19 June 2026 termination* — and the Phase X snippet places the observatory inside the instrument suite: *Platform Erosion Observatory measures custody separation; the Capture Registry measures representation and correction asymmetry*. The registry is cited as an instrument inside a capture that will enter the registry. Literalism at the floor: Arecibo’s collapsed platform (screenshot) and Brittany’s coastal OSIRISC (transcript) surface on the bare words platform/erosion/observatory.

+1
The Platform Erosion Observatory (often tied to the [PID Erosion Observatory](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESSQHuR6pNNUDYtiNy9LkP3sPAHtSK7HmCbqE1HzgWgEyOCSSm-IMmtvJGT_t2TZyzubtCJMm4C_UiFNhutZjE3nZ2nmOqJfbtq8M=) framework) is an empirical digital tracking project that audits and records the silent removal, severance, and erasure of persistent identifiers (such as DOIs and digital records) across online research and data archives. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEB7keqTbo7zF-Zm_yydURf7vVypAvotQPYB4D4ia_iBixfxI5jVe6g2tbUaR2dtF6mEop-oKw5V_VSs5QV4lQO41XSXCEq3tG4ZxgrtL7Gz7yq3hrxbhyVGd5mMQVGFqNIG6R1WaxXXldmKwXuMrCIXAQJAGb-pUr3OaAeA0d-Rpt82RRq9kyJSkXTmguOWJzYAiZO9vdPD8NuWZh9AqzH--xFidDfo44D), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESSQHuR6pNNUDYtiNy9LkP3sPAHtSK7HmCbqE1HzgWgEyOCSSm-IMmtvJGT_t2TZyzubtCJMm4C_UiFNhutZjE3nZ2nmOqJfbtq8M=)]
Core Focus Areas

* Identifier Custody: Tracks when digital objects or repository accounts are terminated and links go dead.
* Removal Censuses: Quantifies large-scale data deletion events and metadata persistence.
* Archival Tracking: Analyzes the structural decay of digital infrastructure over time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESswEB7keqTSQFFVrCgSP1Wwz3A0kjojfN_9lk8EvMhz5vMBj4U_pP8WPKi5UwsZT_cKttoFheYlJxS3gNbZNVL00IHVUq4BboPN7YzaMCiQVjjeEIbdLdrMHS_3t18oT6e2IYGM-YzuH9JLqaMcx5QOZ9B0hMRTZ-NiRcL1mlpcu8jXs2m6XUM-[REDACTED-ZENODO-60chars]==), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEB7keqTbo7zF-Zm_yydURf7vVypAvotQPYB4D4ia_iBixfxI5jVe6g2tbUaR2dtF6mEop-oKw5V_VSs5QV4lQO41XSXCEq3tG4ZxgrtL7Gz7yq3hrxbhyVGd5mMQVGFqNIG6R1WaxXXldmKwXuMrCIXAQJAGb-pUr3OaAeA0d-Rpt82RRq9kyJSkXTmguOWJzYAiZO9vdPD8NuWZh9AqzH--xFidDfo44D), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESSQHuR6pNNUDYtiNy9LkP3sPAHtSK7HmCbqE1HzgWgEyOCSSm-IMmtvJGT_t2TZyzubtCJMm4C_UiFNhutZjE3nZ2nmOqJfbtq8M=)]
